name: LoCoMo (real dataset)
notes: Real LoCoMo (snap-research locomo10.json): multi-session dialogues with real timestamps + QA over the full history. Generate the local pack with `python scripts/build_locomo_benchmark.py --input locomo10.json --id locomo_real` (data/benchmarks/locomo_real/ is gitignored — it repeats the long conversation context per QA). Efficient graphiti_cross_episode runs need shared-graph-per-conversation (ingest each conversation once); attention_baseline runs per-sample as-is.
